data.description: High ROI 2BR | Fully Furnished | Prime Location
data.long_description:
Experience upscale living in this beautifully designed 2-bedroom apartment in Marquis Elegance, located in the vibrant community of Arjan. Offering a spacious layout and premium furnishings, this property is perfect for both end-users and investors seeking modern comfort and strong rental potential.

  Property Details

  Type: 2 Bedroom Apartment
  Size: 120.13 Sq. M.
  Sqft: 1293.06
  Bathrooms: 3
  Furnishing: Fully Furnished
  Kitchen: Fully equipped modern kitchen
  Built-in Wardrobes
  Balcony: Yes
  Parking: 1 Covered Space
  Key Features
  Contemporary open-plan layout with elegant finishes
  Floor-to-ceiling windows allowing natural light
  High-quality furniture and fitted interiors
  Spacious bedrooms with ample storage
  Stylish bathrooms with modern fittings
  Ideal for end-use or investment

  Building Amenities:

  Swimming pool
  Fully equipped gymnasium
  Kids’ play area
  Landscaped areas and leisure zones
  BBQ area
  24/7 security & CCTV
  Covered parking
  Elegant lobby and reception
  Residents enjoy access to premium lifestyle amenities designed for comfort, leisure, and convenience.

  Location Highlights
  Situated in Arjan, Dubailand, Marquis Elegance offers excellent connectivity and a family-friendly environment:

  Easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311)
  Close to Dubai Miracle Garden & Butterfly Garden
  15 mins to Mall of the Emirates
  20 mins to Dubai Marina & Palm Jumeirah
  Nearby schools, supermarkets & healthcare facilities
  The development is part of a growing residential hub known for modern apartments and strong investment appeal.

  Why Choose Marquis Elegance?
  Marquis Elegance offers a blend of modern architecture, premium amenities, and strategic location, making it one of the sought-after developments in Arjan. The project features contemporary apartments designed for a balanced lifestyle with easy access to key areas across Dubai.
